title: N.C.R.B., (M.H.A.) PRISON STATISTICS - 1996 An analysis of the actual staff strength in the jails shows that almost in all the States/UTs from where information had been sent, the actual strength of the Jail Staff posted against the sanctioned strength is quite satisfactory. Kerala, Mizoram, Nagaland and Chandigarh are the states which reported 100% strength during 1996. While in Manipur (105.6%) actual strength was higher than the sanctioned strength.
